name: streamix-app
description: Streamix — the television app: one React front end, packaged for the web, Android, Samsung Tizen and LG webOS.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @iptv/web build && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs apps/web/dist && node scripts/css-compat.mjs apps/web/dist
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core-m3u packages/core-xtream && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core-stalker && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core-store && pnpm --filter @iptv/web exec tsc -b
